verses.original: הָעִ֣זוּ׀ בְּנֵ֣י בִניָמִ֗ן מִקֶּ֙רֶב֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּבִתְק֙וֹעַ֙ תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֔ר וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּ֖רֶם שְׂא֣וּ מַשְׂאֵ֑ת כִּ֥י רָעָ֛ה נִשְׁקְפָ֥ה מִצָּפ֖וֹן וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘i·zū bə·nê ḇi·n·yå̄·min miq·qe·reḇ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇiṯ·qō·w·a‘ tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār wə·‘al- bêṯ hak·ke·rem śə·’ū maś·’êṯ kî rā·‘āh niš·qə·p̄āh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Run for cover O sons of Benjamin flee from Jerusalem Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa send up a signal over Beth-haccherem for disaster looms from the north even great destruction
verses.literalPt: FUGI para salvação vossa, filhos de Benjamim, do meio de Jerusalém; e tocai a buzina em Tecoa, e levantai um sinal de fogo sobre Bete-Haquerém; porque do lado norte surge um mal e uma grande destruição.

verses.original: הַנָּוָה֙ וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָ֔ה דָּמִ֖יתִי בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·wāh wə·ham·mə·‘un·nā·ḡāh dā·mî·ṯî baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Though she is beautiful and delicate I will destroy the Daughter of Zion
verses.literalPt: À formosa e delicada assemelhei a filha de Sião.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֛יהָ יָבֹ֥אוּ רֹעִ֖ים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶ֑ם תָּקְע֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ אֹהָלִים֙ סָבִ֔יב רָע֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·le·hā yā·ḇō·’ū rō·‘îm wə·‘eḏ·rê·hem tā·qə·‘ū ‘ā·le·hā ’ō·hā·lîm sā·ḇîḇ rā·‘ū ’îš ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Shepherds and their flocks will come against her they will pitch . . . their tents all around her . . . each tending his own portion
verses.literalPt: Mas contra ela virão pastores com os seus rebanhos; levantarão contra ela tendas em redor, e cada um apascentará no seu lugar.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה ק֖וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם א֥וֹי לָ֙נוּ֙ כִּי־ פָנָ֣ה הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י יִנָּט֖וּ צִלְלֵי־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū ‘ā·le·hā mil·ḥā·māh qū·mū wə·na·‘ă·leh ḇaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim ’ō·w lā·nū kî- p̄ā·nāh hay·yō·wm kî yin·nā·ṭū ṣil·lê- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Prepare for battle against her rise up let us attack at noon Woe to us for the daylight . . . is fading the evening shadows grow long
verses.literalPt: Preparai a guerra contra ela, levantai-vos, e subamos ao pino do meio dia. Ai de nós! Já declina o dia, já se vão estendendo as sombras da tarde.

verses.original: ק֚וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַלָּ֔יְלָה וְנַשְׁחִ֖יתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: qū·mū wə·na·‘ă·leh ḇal·lā·yə·lāh wə·naš·ḥî·ṯāh ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Rise up let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses
verses.literalPt: Levantai-vos, e subamos de noite, e destruamos os seus palácios.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּרְת֣וּ עֵצָ֔ה וְשִׁפְכ֥וּ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סֹלְלָ֑ה הִ֚יא הָעִ֣יר הָפְקַ֔ד כֻּלָּ֖הּ עֹ֥שֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kir·ṯū ‘ê·ṣāh wə·šip̄·ḵū ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim sō·lə·lāh hî hā·‘îr hā·p̄ə·qaḏ kul·lāh ‘ō·šeq bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem This city must be punished there is nothing but oppression in her midst
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Cortai árvores, e levantai trincheiras contra Jerusalém; esta é a cidade que há de ser castigada, só opressão há no meio dela.

verses.original: כְּהָקִ֥יר בְּוֵר מֵימֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֖ן הֵקֵ֣רָה רָעָתָ֑הּ חָמָ֣ס וָ֠שֹׁד יִשָּׁ֨מַע בָּ֧הּ עַל־ פָּנַ֛י תָּמִ֖יד חֳלִ֥י וּמַכָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·hā·qîr bə·wēr mê·me·hā kên hê·qê·rāh rā·‘ā·ṯāh ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ yiš·šā·ma‘ bāh ‘al- pā·nay tā·mîḏ ḥo·lî ū·mak·kāh
verses.literal: As a well gushes its water so she pours out her evil Violence and destruction resound in her sickness and wounds are ever before Me
verses.literalPt: Como a fonte produz as suas águas, assim ela produz a sua malícia; violência e estrago se ouvem nela; enfermidade e feridas há diante de mim continuamente.

verses.original: הִוָּסְרִי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם פֶּן־ תֵּקַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ פֶּן־ אֲשִׂימֵ֣ךְ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hiw·wā·sə·rî yə·rū·šā·lim pen- tê·qa‘ nap̄·šî mim·mêḵ pen- ’ă·śî·mêḵ šə·mā·māh ’e·reṣ lō·w nō·wō·šā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Be forewarned O Jerusalem or I will turn away from you . . . I will make you a desolation a land without inhabitant
verses.literalPt: Corrige-te, ó Jerusalém, para que a minha alma não se aparte de ti, para que não te torne em assolação e terra não habitada.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עוֹלֵ֛ל יְעוֹלְל֥וּ כַגֶּ֖פֶן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָשֵׁב֙ יָדְךָ֔ כְּבוֹצֵ֖ר עַל־ סַלְסִלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lêl yə·‘ō·wl·lū ḵag·ge·p̄en šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl hā·šêḇ yā·ḏə·ḵā kə·ḇō·w·ṣêr ‘al- sal·sil·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly . . . as a vine Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Diligentemente respigarão os resíduos de Israel como uma vinha; torna a tua mão, como o vindimador, aos cestos.

verses.original: עַל־ מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְאָעִ֙ידָה֙ וְיִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הִנֵּה֙ עֲרֵלָ֣ה אָזְנָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֑יב הִנֵּ֣ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- mî ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh wə·yiš·mā·‘ū hin·nêh ‘ă·rê·lāh ’ā·zə·nām wə·lō yū·ḵə·lū lə·haq·šîḇ hin·nêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh lā·hem lə·ḥer·pāh lō yaḥ·pə·ṣū- ḇōw
verses.literal: To whom can I give this warning Who will listen to me Look their ears are closed so they cannot . . . hear See the word of the LORD has become offensive to them they find no pleasure in it
verses.literalPt: A quem falarei e testemunharei, para que ouça? Eis que os seus ouvidos estão incircuncisos, e não podem ouvir; eis que a palavra do SENHOR é para eles coisa vergonhosa, e não gostam dela.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ חֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה׀ מָלֵ֙אתִי֙ נִלְאֵ֣יתִי הָכִ֔יל שְׁפֹ֤ךְ עַל־ עוֹלָל֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְעַ֛ל ס֥וֹד בַּחוּרִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־ גַם־ אִ֤ישׁ עִם־ אִשָּׁה֙ יִלָּכֵ֔דוּ זָקֵ֖ן עִם־ מְלֵ֥א יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ḥă·maṯ Yah·weh mā·lê·ṯî nil·’ê·ṯî hā·ḵîl šə·p̄ōḵ ‘al- ‘ō·w·lāl ba·ḥūṣ wə·‘al sō·wḏ ba·ḥū·rîm yaḥ·dāw kî- ḡam- ’îš ‘im- ’iš·šāh yil·lā·ḵê·ḏū zā·qên ‘im- mə·lê yā·mîm
verses.literal: But I am full of the LORD’s wrath I am tired of holding it back Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together For both husband and wife will be captured the old and the very old alike . . .
verses.literalPt: Por isso estou cheio do furor do SENHOR; estou cansado de o conter; derramá-lo-ei sobre os meninos pelas ruas e na reunião de todos os jovens; porque até o marido com a mulher serão presos, e o velho com o que está cheio de dias.

verses.original: וְנָסַ֤בּוּ בָֽתֵּיהֶם֙ לַאֲחֵרִ֔ים שָׂד֥וֹת וְנָשִׁ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־ אַטֶּ֧ה אֶת־ יָדִ֛י עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sab·bū ḇāt·tê·hem la·’ă·ḥê·rîm śā·ḏō·wṯ wə·nā·šîm yaḥ·dāw kî- ’aṭ·ṭeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Their houses will be turned over to others their fields and wives as well for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E as suas casas passarão a outros, como também as suas herdades e as suas mulheres juntamente; porque estenderei a minha mão contra os habitantes desta terra, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִקְּטַנָּם֙ וְעַד־ גְּדוֹלָ֔ם כֻּלּ֖וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּמִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־ כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: kî miq·qə·ṭan·nām wə·‘aḏ- gə·ḏō·w·lām kul·lōw bō·w·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ ū·min·nā·ḇî wə·‘aḏ- kō·hên kul·lōw ‘ō·śeh šā·qer
verses.literal: For from the least of them to the greatest all are greedy for gain from prophet to priest all practice deceit
verses.literalPt: Porque desde o menor deles até ao maior, cada um se dá à avareza; e desde o profeta até ao sacerdote, cada um usa de falsidade.

verses.original: וַֽיְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת־ שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּי֙ עַל־ נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵאמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְאֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·rap·pə·’ū ’eṯ- še·ḇer ‘am·mî ‘al- nə·qal·lāh lê·mōr šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm wə·’ên šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: They dress the wound of My people with very little care saying Peace peace when there is no peace at all
verses.literalPt: E curam superficialmente a ferida da filha do meu povo, dizendo: Paz, paz; quando não há paz.

verses.original: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־ בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־ יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ גַּם־ הַכְלִים֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּעֵת־ פְּקַדְתִּ֥ים יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šū kî ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ‘ā·śū gam- bō·wōš lō- yê·ḇō·wō·šū gam- haḵ·lîm lō yā·ḏā·‘ū lā·ḵên yip·pə·lū ḇan·nō·p̄ə·lîm bə·‘êṯ- pə·qaḏ·tîm yik·kā·šə·lū ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed No they have no shame at all . . . they do not even know how to blush So they will fall among the fallen when I punish them they will collapse says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porventura envergonham-se de cometer abominação? Pelo contrário, de maneira nenhuma se envergonham, nem tampouco sabem que coisa é envergonhar-se; portanto cairão entre os que caem; no tempo em que eu os visitar, tropeçarão, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה עִמְדוּ֩ עַל־ דְּרָכִ֨ים וּרְא֜וּ וְשַׁאֲל֣וּ׀ לִנְתִב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֗ם אֵי־ זֶ֨ה דֶ֤רֶךְ הַטּוֹב֙ וּלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ וּמִצְא֥וּ מַרְגּ֖וֹעַ לְנַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘im·ḏū ‘al- də·rā·ḵîm ū·rə·’ū wə·ša·’ă·lū lin·ṯi·ḇō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām ’ê- zeh ḏe·reḵ haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ū·lə·ḵū- ḇāh ū·miṣ·’ū mar·gō·w·a‘ lə·nap̄·šə·ḵem way·yō·mə·rū lō nê·lêḵ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Stand at the crossroads and look Ask for the ancient paths Where . . . is the good way Then walk in it and you will find rest for your souls But they said We will not walk in it
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Ponde-vos nos caminhos, e vede, e perguntai pelas veredas antigas, qual é o bom caminho, e andai por ele; e achareis descanso para as vossas almas; mas eles dizem: Não andaremos nele.

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ צֹפִ֔ים הַקְשִׁ֖יבוּ לְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַקְשִֽׁיב׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ṣō·p̄îm haq·šî·ḇū lə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār way·yō·mə·rū lō naq·šîḇ
verses.literal: I appointed watchmen over you and said Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn But they answered We will not listen
verses.literalPt: Também pus atalaias sobre vós, dizendo: Estai atentos ao som da trombeta; mas dizem: Não escutaremos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּדְעִ֥י עֵדָ֖ה אֶת־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḏə·‘î ‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- ’ă·šer- bām
verses.literal: Therefore hear O nations and learn O congregations what will happen to them
verses.literalPt: Portanto ouvi, vós, nações; e informa-te tu, ó congregação, do que se faz entre eles!

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה פְּרִ֣י מַחְשְׁבוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֤י עַל־ דְּבָרַי֙ לֹ֣א הִקְשִׁ֔יבוּ וְתוֹרָתִ֖י וַיִּמְאֲסוּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘î hā·’ā·reṣ hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh pə·rî maḥ·šə·ḇō·w·ṯām kî ‘al- də·ḇā·ray lō hiq·šî·ḇū wə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî way·yim·’ă·sū- ḇāh
verses.literal: Hear O earth I am bringing disaster on this people the fruit of their own schemes because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction
verses.literalPt: Ouve tu, ó terra! Eis que eu trarei mal sobre este povo, o próprio fruto dos seus pensamentos; porque não estão atentos às minhas palavras, e rejeitam a minha lei.

verses.original: לָמָּה־ זֶּ֨ה לִ֤י לְבוֹנָה֙ מִשְּׁבָ֣א תָב֔וֹא וְקָנֶ֥ה הַטּ֖וֹב מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מֶרְחָ֑ק עֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ לֹ֣א לְרָצ֔וֹן וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם לֹא־ עָ֥רְבוּ לִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- zeh lî lə·ḇō·w·nāh miš·šə·ḇā ṯā·ḇō·w wə·qā·neh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ mê·’e·reṣ mer·ḥāq ‘ō·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem lō lə·rā·ṣō·wn wə·ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem lō- ‘ā·rə·ḇū lî
verses.literal: What use . . . to Me is frankincense from Sheba . . . or sweet cane from a distant land Your burnt offerings are not acceptable . . . your sacrifices do not please Me
verses.literalPt: Para que, pois, me vem o incenso de Sabá e a melhor cana aromática de terras remotas? Vossos holocaustos não me agradam, nem me são suaves os vossos sacrifícios.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן אֶל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִכְשֹׁלִ֑ים וְכָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֠ם אָב֨וֹת וּבָנִ֥ים יַחְדָּ֛ו שָׁכֵ֥ן וְרֵע֖וֹ יֹאבֵדוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯên ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh miḵ·šō·lîm wə·ḵā·šə·lū ḇām ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ū·ḇā·nîm yaḥ·dāw šā·ḵên wə·rê·‘ōw yō·ḇē·ḏū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD . . . says I will lay stumbling blocks before this people fathers and sons alike will be staggered friends and neighbors will perish
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que armarei tropeços a este povo; e tropeçarão neles pais e filhos juntamente; o vizinho e o seu companheiro perecerão.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן וְג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nêh ‘am bā mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl yê·‘ō·wr mî·yar·kə·ṯê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Behold an army is coming from the land of the north a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que um povo vem da terra do norte, e uma grande nação se levantará das extremidades da terra.

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִיד֞וֹן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָם֙ כַּיָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְעַל־ סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּאִישׁ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִךְ בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: qe·šeṯ wə·ḵî·ḏō·wn ya·ḥă·zî·qū ’aḵ·zā·rî hū wə·lō yə·ra·ḥê·mū qō·w·lām kay·yām ye·hĕ·meh wə·‘al- sū·sîm yir·kā·ḇū ‘ā·rūḵ kə·’îš lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·la·yiḵ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: They grasp the bow and spear they are cruel and merciless Their voice roars like the sea and they ride upon horses lined up like men in formation against you O Daughter of Zion
verses.literalPt: Arco e lança trarão; são cruéis, e não usarão de misericórdia; a sua voz rugirá como o mar, e em cavalos virão montados, dispostos como homens de guerra contra ti, ó filha de Sião.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ אֶת־ שָׁמְע֖וֹ רָפ֣וּ יָדֵ֑ינוּ צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְנוּ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·nū ’eṯ- šā·mə·‘ōw rā·p̄ū yā·ḏê·nū ṣā·rāh he·ḥĕ·zî·qaṯ·nū ḥîl kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh
verses.literal: We have heard the report our hands hang limp Anguish has gripped us pain like that of a woman in labor
verses.literalPt: Ouvimos a sua fama, afrouxaram-se as nossas mãos; angústia nos tomou, e dores como as de parturiente.

verses.original: אַל־ תֵּצְאִי הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וּבַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אַל־ תֵּלֵכִי כִּ֚י חֶ֣רֶב לְאֹיֵ֔ב מָג֖וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tē·ṣə·ʾī haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇad·de·reḵ ’al- tē·lē·ḵī kî ḥe·reḇ lə·’ō·yêḇ mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Do not go out to the fields do not walk the road For the enemy has a sword terror is on every side
verses.literalPt: Não saiais ao campo, nem andeis pelo caminho; porque espada do inimigo e espanto há ao redor.

verses.original: בַּת־ עַמִּ֤י חִגְרִי־ שָׂק֙ וְהִתְפַּלְּשִׁ֣י בָאֵ֔פֶר אֵ֤בֶל יָחִיד֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ מִסְפַּ֖ד תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים כִּ֣י פִתְאֹ֔ם יָבֹ֥א הַשֹּׁדֵ֖ד עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: baṯ- ‘am·mî ḥiḡ·rî- śāq wə·hiṯ·pal·lə·šî ḇā·’ê·p̄er ’ê·ḇel yā·ḥîḏ ‘ă·śî lāḵ mis·paḏ tam·rū·rîm kî p̄iṯ·’ōm yā·ḇō haš·šō·ḏêḏ ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: O daughter of my people dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes Mourn with bitter wailing as you would for an only son for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us
verses.literalPt: Ó filha do meu povo, cinge-te de saco, e revolve-te na cinza; pranteia como por um filho único, pranto de amargura; porque de repente virá o destruidor sobre nós.

verses.original: בָּח֛וֹן נְתַתִּ֥יךָ בְעַמִּ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר וְתֵדַ֕ע וּבָחַנְתָּ֖ אֶת־ דַּרְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ḥō·wn nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā ḇə·‘am·mî miḇ·ṣār wə·ṯê·ḏa‘ ū·ḇā·ḥan·tā ’eṯ- dar·kām
verses.literal: I have appointed you to examine My people like ore so you may know and try their ways
verses.literalPt: Por torre de guarda te pus entre o meu povo, por fortaleza, para que soubesses e examinasses o seu caminho.

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ סָרֵ֣י סֽוֹרְרִ֔ים הֹלְכֵ֥י רָכִ֖יל נְחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל כֻּלָּ֥ם מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām sā·rê sō·wr·rîm hō·lə·ḵê rā·ḵîl nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel kul·lām maš·ḥî·ṯîm hêm·māh
verses.literal: All are hardened rebels walking around as slanderers They are bronze and iron all of them are corrupt . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos eles são os mais rebeldes, andam murmurando; são duros como bronze e ferro; todos eles são corruptores.

verses.original: נָחַ֣ר מַפֻּ֔חַ מֵאִשְׁתַּם עֹפָ֑רֶת לַשָּׁוְא֙ צָרַ֣ף צָר֔וֹף וְרָעִ֖ים לֹ֥א נִתָּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥar map·pu·aḥ mē·ʾiš·tam ‘ō·p̄ā·reṯ laš·šāw ṣā·rap̄ ṣā·rō·wp̄ wə·rā·‘îm lō nit·tā·qū
verses.literal: The bellows blow fiercely blasting away the lead with fire The refining proceeds . . . in vain for the wicked are not purged
verses.literalPt: Já o fole se queimou, o chumbo se consumiu com o fogo; em vão fundiu o fundidor tão diligentemente, pois os maus não são arrancados.

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִמְאָ֔ס קָרְא֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ מָאַ֥ס יְהוָ֖ה בָּהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ nim·’ās qā·rə·’ū lā·hem kî- mā·’as Yah·weh bā·hem
verses.literal: They are called rejected silver because the LORD has rejected them
verses.literalPt: Prata rejeitada lhes chamarão, porque o SENHOR os rejeitou.
